description: This PHP source file defines the StatMigration class, which handles data migration tasks for ad statistics in the Revive Adserver project. It includes methods for migrating raw and compacted statistics, creating temporary tables, and correcting campaign targets.

classes.name: StatMigration
classes.description: A class responsible for migrating ad statistics data, including raw and compacted stats, and correcting campaign targets within the Revive Adserver system.

methods.name: migrateData
methods.description: Determines whether to migrate compacted or raw stats and calls the appropriate method.

methods.name: migrateCompactStats
methods.description: Migrates compacted ad statistics into intermediate and summary tables.

methods.name: migrateRawStats
methods.description: Migrates raw ad statistics, creating temporary tables and aggregating data.

methods.name: migrateStats
methods.description: Executes SQL to migrate data into summary tables and handles error logging.

methods.name: _getOperationIntervalInfo
methods.description: Retrieves operation interval IDs and date ranges for migration.

methods.name: statsCompacted
methods.description: Checks configuration to determine if stats are compacted.

methods.name: _modifyTableName
methods.description: Returns quoted table name for SQL queries.

methods.name: correctCampaignTargets
methods.description: Adjusts campaign target statistics by aggregating and updating campaign data.
